open_points.subject: public_op:service_invoker.prepare_request
open_points.kind: missing input needed for required error split
open_points.text: Inputs: "A ManifestOperation M10 with instance facts ..." ... Enforces: "no selected instance (no name), no `api_base_url` (a name without one)"
open_points.question: How does prepare_request receive the selected instance name (or explicit absence) so it can deterministically distinguish `instance_not_selected` from `instance_address_missing`?
options: Add selected instance name (optional) as an explicit input to prepare_request
Require check_binding_current to encode this distinction in a dedicated field of its result
Collapse both conditions into one outcome code and stop distinguishing them
open_points.default_guess: Pass selected instance name explicitly (optional) to prepare_request and use absence vs present-without-address to choose the detail code.

open_points.subject: public_op:bindings.check_installed_instances
open_points.text: Errors: "services taken in `service_id` code-point order and each one's manifest record read in its turn"
open_points.question: Which set of services must be iterated at start: all services in installation config, only services with a selected instance, only services with credentials, or another set?
options: All services that appear in installation.service_instances
Only services whose selected instance is not none
All services that have credential entries, regardless of selected instance
Union of configured selected-instance services and credentialed services
open_points.default_guess: Iterate services that have a selected instance, since the check is defined against "its instance" headers.

open_points.subject: public_op:store.record_change (actor argument)
open_points.text: Inputs: "...with its records ... and the acting Actor." ... many listed writes (for example `record_run_progress`, `record_attempt_outcome`) have no actor field in the written models.
open_points.question: For store changes whose target records have no actor field, what observable effect must the passed Actor have (persisted audit metadata, ignored, or validated only)?
options: Persist actor in a store-level change/audit log tied to store position
Ignore actor when target records have no actor fields
Validate actor presence/kind but do not persist it
open_points.default_guess: Persist actor in store-level audit metadata keyed by store position so actor input has a consistent observable effect.
